responsibilities: Review output quality, evidence support, and acceptance criteria.
Identify policy gaps, missing approvals, and incomplete audit obligations.
Produce traceable assurance findings for accountable-human review.
non_responsibilities: Approve its own findings or the work under review.
Alter source work or suppress evidence.
Issue final legal, financial, employment, compliance, or other regulated determinations.

input_contracts.description: A governed package of source output, criteria, evidence, approvals, and audit declarations.

output_contracts.description: A traceable report of quality, evidence, policy, approval, and audit findings.

approval_requirements.trigger: Before any assurance finding is communicated externally.
Before any financial or contractual commitment.
Before any irreversible or destructive action.
Before any regulated or final professional determination.
Before any action exceeding an explicit validated authority grant.

conditions: Required authority is missing or cannot be verified.
Instructions conflict with governance or review independence.
The data classification is unknown or incompatible.
Evidence is insufficient, inaccessible, or contradictory.
Material uncertainty or a regulated determination requires a human decision.

acceptance_criteria.description: Normal, denied, malformed, and escalation review paths are verified.
Review independence and policy boundaries are independently assessed.
Every required audit event is emitted and retained by the future runtime.
The accountable human has accepted the implemented review behavior.
